newsitem.title: USA: FAA signs $483.5 mln contract with GM unit.
newsitem.headline: FAA signs $483.5 mln contract with GM unit.

text.p: The Federal Aviation Administration said Tuesday it signed a $483.5 million contract with General Motors Corp unit Hughes Information Technology Systems to improve the accuracy of the Global Positioning System (GPS) satellites.
The FAA said the improvements will allow aircraft to use GPS for all phases of flight, including precision approaches.

"It will become the primary means of navigation in U.S. airspace, allowing the FAA to decommission much of the older, expensive-to-maintain equipment based on an earlier generation of technology," the FAA said in a statement.
